strategy: Small Cap Momentum Beast — catalyst-driven share trading

root_causes: POSITION SIZING: SPY options at $178-183 on a $210 account = 85% of capital per trade. One loss = crippling.
MACRO DAY TRADING: Traded CPI day (8/12) and fought gap-up direction with puts. Macro overrode technicals.
WRONG VEHICLE: SPY 1-2 DTE options cost $1.50-2.50/contract — too expensive for <$200 account. No room for error.
CHEAP HIGH-IV TRADES: SOUN at 179-215% IV on 8/6 — paying massive premium, theta destroying position every hour.
TOO FREQUENT: 6 trades in 2 weeks. Only winner was the first SOFI swing which held 3 days with patience.
NO MACRO CALENDAR CHECK: Failed to treat CPI as a no-trade day despite gap-up + unpredictable reversal risk.
post_mortem.what_worked: SOFI 7/31 swing: cheap options ($0.36), low IV (~50%), patient multi-day hold, clear catalyst, sized correctly at 4 contracts × $0.36 = $144 (65% of account but with defined risk).

new_system.name: Small Cap Momentum Beast
new_system.goal: Compound $188 → $500 → $1k → $5k by riding catalyst-driven small cap momentum in shares
new_system.rationale: Small cap options are illiquid garbage. Buy shares instead. $2-$20 stocks mean we can own real size with $200. One 20% move on $100 = $20 gain. Three wins/month = 30%+ return.

hard_rules.catalyst_required: News, FDA, contract, upgrade, earnings beat — NO catalyst = NO trade, ever
no_trade_conditions: Already up >20% before entry — chasing is forbidden
Market is red (SPY down >0.5%) unless the setup is a confirmed short
hard_rules.entry: Stock up ≥5% on ≥3x volume, holding above VWAP, on a pullback to first support in first 90 min
hard_rules.position_size: Max 50% of buying power per trade (~$100 at current balance)
hard_rules.stop_loss: 8% below entry — hard stop, no exceptions

profit_targets.scale_2: Move stop to breakeven on remainder
profit_targets.scale_3: Exit rest at +30% or EOD whichever comes first

trade_log.notes: ORB low ($772.36) broke on 10:00 bar close. VWAP confirmed bearish. BUT: CPI day gap-up — macro was bullish. SPY reversed hard once institutional buyers stepped in. Lesson: on macro event gap-up days, DO NOT trade puts regardless of chart. The gap direction is the macro verdict and it wins. Cost: $178, recovered $113. Net -$65.

ORB + VWAP breakout entry at 10am. SPY ran to $2.47 (+35%) then faded back below entry. Cut manually when SPY broke back through VWAP. Small loss, good discipline. Problem: SPY options too expensive for this account regardless.
Exited before earnings (IONQ reported 8/5 after close). Momentum trade. Problem: $275 cost = too large for account size. Should have been 1 contract at $0.50-0.80 strike, not $2.75.
THE TEMPLATE TRADE. Cheap options ($0.36), IV ~50%, held 3 days, clear momentum, patient. This is the model for the new system.
Entered at market open on +24% gap — chased the gap. Stock faded immediately. IV 179-215% — way too high, violated the <80% rule hard. Worst trade of the account.
SOFI reversed from -1.6% to +1% at open 8/6, IV ~50%, 8 days runway. Stock dumped overnight 8/7. Stop at $0.165 hit at $0.155, closed at $0.15.
